Super Artemis 1.1.0 brings profile reordering, automatic network reconnection, smart quality recovery when Wi-Fi returns, dock rail quick bars with inactivity auto-hide, a unified find panel for keys and gestures, expanded 2-finger and 1-finger touch gestures, full virtual keyboard function row expansion, in-stream menu section reordering with real-time preview, complete translations across all 21 languages, and a comprehensive set of fixes for picture-in-picture, shortcut icons, and streaming stability.

**Install:** `SuperArtemis-v1.1.0-arm64-v8a.apk` installs as `com.mohitarora.superartemis`. Automatic update tracking is supported through [Obtainium](https://github.com/Arora-Sir/Super-Artemis#super-artemis).

## What's new in 1.1.0

### Connectivity and Network Resilience
- Automatic network drop resumer: when the network drops, an unobtrusive status card displays over the last decoded frame while the app probes saved host addresses (local, manual, IPv6, VPN) and seamlessly restores the connection without terminating the session.
- Wi-Fi return quality restart: when a stream starts on mobile data with a metered bitrate and Wi-Fi becomes available, the app verifies host reachability over Wi-Fi and automatically restarts the stream to ramp back up to full unmetered bitrate.
- Silence watchdog overlay: renders a status label in the top-left corner over the last decoded frame during transient host silence without destroying the display surface.

### In-Stream Quick Action Bars
- Three distinct quick bar styles: Dock rail (a sleek rounded translucent container, the new default), Round buttons (individual circular action buttons), and Tap to expand (a subtle edge handle that expands on tap and tucks away after a pause).
- Inactivity auto-hide: automatically dims and conceals quick action bars after a customizable idle interval (3, 5, 10, or 15 seconds) leaving a discreet edge peek tab, and instantly wakes upon screen touch.
- Quick bar toggle action: assignable to menu items, physical hotkeys, macro flows, or multi-finger gestures to manually hide or reveal on-screen action bars.
- Live bar editor preview: preview quick bar styles and layouts directly inside the Quick-action bars editor before saving.

### In-Stream Menu and Section Reordering
- In-stream menu section reordering: customize the order of Quick Menu sections (Actions, Session, Menu) directly within the in-stream Customize menu under a new Section order tab.
- Real-time preview: reordering sections immediately updates the scaled in-stream menu preview in real time before saving.
- Compact Quick Menu grid: refined spacing (80 dp columns and 68 dp tile height) allowing more actions to display without vertical scrolling.
- Menu style picker action: switch between List, Grid with icons, and Compact styles directly from in-stream actions.

### Custom Keys, Keyboard and Search
- Unified Find panel: searchable across the quick action bar editor and multi-finger gestures editor with text query filtering and an interactive keyboard chord test mode.
- Basic keys prioritization: Backspace and Delete placed at the front of the default keys catalog with dedicated vector icons.
- Windows Magnifier shortcuts: native built-in keys for Magnifier In, Magnifier Out, and Exit Magnifier with distinct vector display icons.
- Function row Fn switch: toggle between F1-F12 and F13-F24 function keys dynamically on the built-in on-screen keyboard.
- Optional permanent F13 to F24 row: user preference to display a dedicated F13-F24 row directly above the standard function keys.
- Elevation and layer ordering: virtual keyboard renders with elevated z-order above quick action bars to eliminate touch interference during typing.

### Gestures and Profiles
- Expanded gesture engine: full support for 2-finger taps, double taps, holds, and directional swipes, plus 1-finger double tap and hold with non-destructive pass-through.
- Profiles drag-and-drop reordering: drag connection profiles by their drag handle or long press to customize display order across app sessions.

### Localization and User Interface
- Complete localization across all 21 supported languages with zero missing resource entries.
- Instant in-app language switching: changes apply immediately to the active window without process restarts or black screen flash.
- Android 13+ per-app language selection: the Default language entry follows the language configured in Android system settings.
- Consistent Settings iconography: dedicated action icons applied across all navigation and interactive preference rows.

## Fixes and stability improvements
- Picture-in-picture zoom and pan fix: fixed cropped and shrunken stream rendering with black borders on Samsung One UI and Android devices when custom zoom or pan was saved. The stream now scales fully to the PiP window and restores saved zoom and pan on return.
- Picture-in-picture dialog cleanup: automatically closes open menus, search panels, and editor dialogs when entering picture-in-picture so dialogs never render cut off in the small PiP window.
- Pinned desktop shortcut icon centering: eliminated dark side bars and off-center cropping on launcher shortcuts. IconComposer centers box art and lettering within the launcher safe zone and updates existing pinned shortcuts.
- Network drop watchdog race condition: fixed crash on early stream restart where watchdog ticks queried destroyed native mutexes.
- Multi-address network resumption: auto-resumer probes all saved addresses of the PC (local, manual, VPN, IPv6), resolving reconnection failures when switching from Wi-Fi to mobile data.
- Automatic quality restart ramp-up: stream automatically restarts when an unmetered network returns and the PC answers a reachability probe, restoring full unmetered bitrate.
- High-DPI quick bar preview scaling: fixed overlapping buttons and landscape letterboxing in the bar editor preview on high-resolution displays.
- Landscape search extract UI prevention: search inputs in the Find panel and Settings configure flags to prevent the software keyboard from taking over the full screen in landscape.
- Single-character symbol representation: fixed dual-character display for punctuation keys in Find panel chord detection.
- ShortcutTrampoline activity stack race: prevented Task.mLaunchNextToBubble null pointer crash on Android 16 and 17 devices by omitting premature finish calls before starting the destination stack (upstream qiin2333/moonlight-vplus#778).
- MediaCodec decoder reconstruction exception handling: worker threads and recovery monitors are safely released upon decoder configuration errors, avoiding process deadlock (upstream qiin2333/moonlight-vplus#783).
- High-contrast placeholder tiles: updated placeholder desktop and app tiles with dark text for clear readability when box art is unavailable.
- Audio and keyboard guidance: documented multi-client Apollo microphone handling and host AutoHotkey Alt+F4 physical key injection pass-through in documentation.
